response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM r) AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
